title: Judge the one-action style check only on mixed spots seen at least 10 times
description: Follow-up from TASK-6.30 (decision-9: Q-1 B, N = 10). Over 100,000 all-TAG hands at 3 seats (seed 42) TAG preflop-limpers comes up once (recommended 1, alternative 0), so --check-styles exits 1 although every band holds. Apply the REQ-028 fit criterion as reworded by TASK-6.30: a mixed spot is judged only when recommended + alternative >= 10; spots with 1 to 9 decisions keep their Mixed spot line unchanged and get a separate line 'Not judged (fewer than 10 decisions): <style> <spot>'; 0/0 spots pass as today. Change the rule in src/playtest/style-check.ts (formatStyleReport, the oneAction list); no new counter. Locked re-pins, each unlocked under its owner(s): tests/playtest/check-styles.acceptance.test.ts never-mixing case mixedSpots(300) (owners TASK-6.11 and TASK-6.25, unlock under both; unopened is about 8 decisions at 300 hands, so it stops failing; re-pin to enough hands, e.g. 1,000, about 33); tests/playtest/check-styles-three-seats.acceptance.test.ts (owner TASK-7.46; restore exit 0 and Style check: passed). Unlocked: tests/playtest/style-check.test.ts 5/0 and 0/5 cases, usage text in src/playtest/cli.ts:60 and tests/playtest/cli.test.ts:115 and :632. Keep the never-mixing fast test fast. Update the comments in tests/playtest/check-styles-three-seats.acceptance.test.ts:9 and docs/advice/range-model.md:294 to cite the REQ-028 fit criterion, not REQ-027.5. Evidence: doit/TASK-6.30/spec.md section 3.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a --check-styles run where a mixed spot came up 1 to 9 times, When it reports, Then that spot's Mixed spot line is printed unchanged, a separate line "Not judged (fewer than 10 decisions): <style> <spot>" follows the Mixed spot lines, and the spot does not fail the check
Given a mixed spot that came up 10 or more times with one count 0, When it reports, Then "One action only: ..." is printed and the run exits 1 (9/0 passes, 10/0 fails, 0/0 passes)

Given npm run playtest -- --hands 100000 --seed 42 --size 3 --check-styles, When it completes, Then it prints "Style check: passed" with no "One action only" line and exits 0, and tests/playtest/check-styles-three-seats.acceptance.test.ts asserts exit 0 and "Style check: passed" again so its name is accurate (owner TASK-7.46); the "Not judged (fewer than 10 decisions)" line is proven end to end by a fast run that fails today (TASK-6.31 Q-1)

Given the locked never-mixing case of tests/playtest/check-styles.acceptance.test.ts (owners TASK-6.11 and TASK-6.25, unlock under both), When it is re-pinned to enough hands that preflop-unopened comes up at least 10 times, Then it still exits 1 with One action only: TAG preflop-unopened, and the 100,000-hand Mixed 6-max slow test still passes on seeds 42, 7 and 1234
Given the --check-styles usage text and tests/playtest/cli.test.ts, When --help is shown, Then it states that a mixed spot is judged only when it came up at least 10 times
Given docs/stats/style-stats.md and docs/advice/range-model.md, When the story is done, Then they state the 10-decision minimum and that 3-seat --check-styles now exits 0 over 100,000 hands

implementationNotes: AC#3 reworded per Q-1 (user 2026-11-28): the 3-seat run already passes on main (TAG preflop-limpers 0/0 since TASK-7.40-7.42), so the Not judged line is proven by a new fast 1,000-hand mixed 6-max test instead.
